step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts and open the Agreement Document.
Select the read-only field in the document (Protection Mode= Full Access).

ol.li: Select the read-only field in the document (Protection Mode= Insert Comments and Track Changes).
You will see a Microsoft Word's warning message, click Yes to continue with the delete operation.
Go to Microsoft Word ribbon and click Review tab.
Click Accept, to accept the delete changes. The content control of the read only field is deleted but the text value remains.
Select the text value and press Delete or Backspace.
Repeat steps 3 and 4. You need to Accept the delete changes twice.

postreq.p: Now the complete read only field is deleted.
